children: Pason reported Q3 2026 revenue of $119.1M, up 18% year over year, and net income of $18.9M ($0.24 per share), versus $12.5M ($0.16 per share) in Q3 2025. It declared a quarterly dividend of C$0.13 per share, unchanged.
Broad growth was led by North American Drilling and increased Solar and Energy Storage deliveries.
Earnings improved, partly reflecting lower expenses tied to a prior litigation settlement as well as higher Adjusted EBITDA.
Growth reflects North American operating leverage; the EBITDA margin edged down to 37.9% from 38.1%.
Dividend unchanged at C$0.13 per share
The regular payout was maintained; payment is scheduled for Dec. 31 to holders of record Dec. 17, 2026.
2026 capex expected near lower end of $60M-$70M
Completions activity gaps defer some investment timing; 2027 capex is anticipated at $65M-$75M.

This is a quarterly results update showing stronger North American drilling and Solar and Energy Storage revenue, alongside uneven Completions activity. Further activity gains and delivery timing, particularly in Completions and Solar and Energy Storage, will determine whether growth continues in coming quarters.
Based on the original press release from Pason Systems Inc. distributed by PR Newswire.
